newsitem.title: USA: Waban begins tender for $100 mln 11pct notes.
newsitem.headline: Waban begins tender for $100 mln 11pct notes.

text.p: Waban Inc said Wednesday it would start a cash tender offer for all of its outstanding 11 percent senior subordinate notes due May 15 2004 with a principal amount of $100 million.

The offer and withdrawal rights will expire at 0800 EDT /1200 GMT on July 17, the company said. It added the offer includes the purchase price plus accrued and unpaid interest up to, but not including, July 17.
The company said the notes' purchase price will be calculated in the following manner:
--The yield on the 6.375 percent U.S. Treasury Note due May 15 1999 at 1400 EDT/1800 GMT on the tenth business day preceeding the expiration date.
The company added the purchase price would have been 112.008 percent of the principal amount based on the above-mentioned yield on June 17.
The offer is conditional on the satisfaction of certain conditions of Waban's proposed spin-off of the common stock of BJ's Wholesale Club Inc, but not on the consummnation of that deal, Waban said.
